scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Halt!
What brings you here, Adventurer?
We've discovered a new floor of this underwater city.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
站住！
冒險者，你來這裡做什麼？
我們發現了這座水下城市的新樓層。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Do you think you're up to the challenge?
The monsters here are between levels 110 and 124.
And you must beware of the Kraken!
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你覺得你能應對這個挑戰嗎？
這裡的魔物等級在110到124之間。
而且你必須小心魔鬼大烏賊！

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Be cautious and good luck.
If you see the Kraken be sure you have your friends to help or do what we do and run.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
請小心，祝你好運。
如果你看到魔鬼大烏賊，確保有朋友幫忙，或者像我們一樣逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
It's always best to be prepared before exploring a new area.
Come back when you're ready to go.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
在探索新區域之前，最好做好充分準備。
等你準備好了再回來。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
So I guess you want to go back to the fifth floor?
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
看來你想回到第五層？

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
You're not going?
You're braver than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你不走？
你比我想像的更勇敢。
